messages:
maria: quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/5123 is a hotfix for the KV-cache mem leak. CI is green (unit + e2e), integration job passed.

maria: we need two reviewers to approve before the 18:00 PT deploy window otherwise it gets deferred to tomorrow's window. low-risk but customer-facing. tagging for visibility. @jonathan @priya @leo

jonathan: looking now, will do a quick pass. any perf regressions?

maria: no perf diff on the perf-run, diff is just a null-check and a small refactor around cache eviction.

priya: I'm mid-sprint but can do a focused review. can you paste the change snippet?

maria: here —
```diff
- if (!cache) return;
+ if (cache == nullptr) return;
+ // ensure kv-tombstones are handled to avoid use-after-free
```

leo: I can be a second pair if needed, but I may be ~30m to finish another review. if someone can start, I can try to pick up the second approver.

release-bot: Deploy cutoff for today is 18:00 PT (in ~26m). Any PRs requiring approvals after cutoff will be queued for next window.

jonathan: left inline comments but nothing blocking, added :+1: — LGTM from me after those nits.

priya: gave a minor suggestion (log line wording). tested locally, behavior looks correct. LGTM.

maria: thank you both!! will merge at head-of-queue. merging now with squash.

maria: /merge --squash https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/5123

release-bot: PR 5123 merged into main by maria at 2026-03-17T17:59:40Z. Rolling deploy started.

maria: monitoring post-deploy metrics, will call out if anything spikes. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :tada:

leo: nice, glad we got it in before cutoff.

priya: good catch — great teamwork.

jonathan: I pushed a tiny follow-up to remove a debug log, won't affect this release.
